extracted.name: Toffee Sauce
extracted.description: Sweetened condensed milk, brown sugar, corn syrup and butter are cooked on the stove until thick to make this sweet caramel sauce.
instruction_lines: In a medium saucepan over medium heat, melt butter. Stir in brown sugar, corn syrup, water and condensed milk. Cook and stir until thickened. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla.
